Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: CI Workflow
on:
  # Run this workflow every time a new commit pushed to upstream/fork repository.
  # Run workflow on fork repository will help contributors find and resolve issues before sending a PR.
  push:
    # Exclude branches created by Dependabot to avoid triggering current workflow
    # for PRs initiated by Dependabot.
    branches-ignore:
      - 'dependabot/**'
  pull_request:
# https://docs.github.com/en/actions/using-workflows/workflow-syntax-for-github-actions#concurrency
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.actor }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
permissions:
  contents: read  # for actions/checkout to fetch code  
jobs:
  golangci:
    name: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: verify license
        run: hack/verify-license.sh
      - name: vendor
        run: hack/verify-vendor.sh
      - name: lint
        run: hack/verify-staticcheck.sh
      - name: import alias
        run: hack/verify-import-aliases.sh
  codegen:
    name: codegen
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: verify codegen
        run: hack/verify-codegen.sh
      - name: verify crdgen
        run: hack/verify-crdgen.sh
      - name: verify protobuf
        run: hack/verify-estimator-protobuf.sh
      - name: verify swagger docs
        run: hack/verify-swagger-docs.sh
      - name: verify command line flags
        run: hack/verify-command-line-flags.sh
      - name: verify lifted docs
        run: hack/verify-lifted.sh
  build:
    name: compile
    needs: codegen # rely on codegen successful completion
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Number of commits to fetch. 0 indicates all history for all branches and tags.
          # We need to guess version via git tags.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: compile
        run: make all
  test:
    name: unit test
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      GOTESTSUM_ENABLED: enabled
    steps:
      - name: checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - name: install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
      - name: make test
        run: make test
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        # Prevent running from the forked repository that doesn't need to upload coverage.
        # In addition, running on the forked repository would fail as missing the necessary secret.
        if: ${{ github.repository == 'karmada-io/karmada' }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check

Cancel superseded runs

Pattern: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (stale_run_cancellation)

When is cancel superseded runs applicable?

Assess cancel superseded runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Runs represent the same workflow and branch or PR; A newer revision supersedes older checks

Contraindications: Release or deployment work; Distinct branches share a cancellation group

Method: Partition cancellation by workflow and branch/PR; Preserve run identity and audit records

Reported finding: Superseding runs can reduce duplicate work.
